content: Jaatian hen jisí bi naihoh quehax Papan yonoti huesti botopaqueti. Hihtihosi cadenaya jahuí, hahan xehpoti llave rihbi xecohax.

Joxon cahen jaa capepahhuan yahtanquin. Jaa capepan jane huetsa cahen rono xeni, huetsa jahuen jane cahen Tiroma Yoshin, huetsa jahuen jane cahen Satanas. Mil bari jaa tiroma yoshin nexáscanon cahen jahuen cadenanen jaa nexaquin.
Nexaxon nemimahhuan qui potaquin. Potaxon jahuen xehpotinin xehpoxon boyaquin, jahuen mil bari senennon caman. Jaa pecaho ta basima tahni nihnon hahquirihbi quehpentihiqui.

Jaatian hen jisí bi hahan tsahoxon jonibo yonoti tsahotibo hichahi. Jano cahen tsahotaibo jai, jonibo yononoxon haponahue Papan jato jaah jano tsahocani. Jesusen joi jeneyamahibo copi textenihbo yamanicabo jano jaribihi, Papan joi jeneyamahi copi textenihbo, hino qui betíhihyamanibo, jahuen santo qui betíhihyamanibo, jaton bemanan qui tiroma yoshiman jane huishamayamanibo, jaton mequen qui jahuen jane huishamayamanibo jaabo rihbi jano jai, textexon rehtenihbo yamanicabo. Hahquirihbi jihuexon cahen Cristo betan mil bari yonocanquin.
Texe yamanicabo jascayamahi: jaabo cahen mil bari senennon caman jihueyamahi. Hen yohihi Cristo betan yonohibo ta jahuen huenimenonicabo qui.

Criston huenimenonicabo ta jahuenahbo qui, jaan hahxonah hihti jenimahibo. Jaabo cahen mahuayosmabo sca, jenquetsahax hahquirihbi mahuatimabo, Papa Dios betan yohuanyaxihquibo, Cristo betan yohuanyaxihquibo. Mil bari ta Cristo betan yonoyaxihcanihqui.
Jahuen mil bari queyoscaiya sca ta quehpenxon cainmaha jahuen sipo quinihoh quehax Satanas picoyaxihquiqui.

Picoxon ta jatihibi mai janin jihuetaibo jaan paranyaxihquiqui, jatihibi texpa janin jihuetaibo paranquin. Gog janeya mai mehaboya Magog janeya mai mehabo. Paranxon ta jato hioyaxihquiqui, Papa Dios betan rehtenani bohábo. Jaan paranxon tsinquihah cahen hichahi topontimahi, texpa quexa mashi bero jai tihi.

Hen jisí bi mai mehabo tsinqui tsinquixon Papan jihuetahbo rehtecatsihquin jano jaabo jai jato bahi xehpohahtanbohancanquin. Papan jihuetahbaan jema janin jaibo jatihibi rehtenoxon cahen hichaxon xehpohahtanbohancanquin. Papan jihuetahbo rehtecatsihscaibaan bi naihoh quehax chihi paqueti. Satanas chibanaibo qui paquexon jato queyobahinquin.

Jato parannica yoshin bihxon sca chihi hianencanya Papan potaquin. Jano jan yoshin hinoya jahuen quesa yoshin potani janin Satanas sca potarihbiquin. Jano potahah cahen jascabi mapohi. Chihi tenebahinaxon teneshinaxon jascabijaquin teneti jai, chihi nocayosma.
Yamanicabo tsinquixon noquen Hihbaan jato casticanai

Jaatian hen jisí bi haaani tsahoti, hihtihosi tsahoti joxoni. Hahan tsahoxon jonibo casticanti. Noquen Hihbo hahan tsahoscai bi hean jisquin. Jaan yohihah cahen naiyahpa mai yamacahinscai, jahuenbi yamascai.

Yamanicabo sca hicha hean jisquin, patoroboya jaton jonibo hihpahonibo, Papa Dios bebon nichinah manataibo rahsi. Jato casticannoxon cahen hicha huishayahpa quiricabo caxquexon huetsa rihbi noquen Hihbaan caxquehah. Jaa quirica huesti cahen jihuenicabaana. Jano nichi yamanicabo tiromabo quen jaabo tiromahi jihuepahoni huishapaquenihxon jaa joi jato nincamapaquexon sca jato casticanscaquin.

Noquen Hihbo bebon nichibo cahen caibo jene meran canish bi jaa bebon sca nichibo, caibo cahen mahuanish bi jaa bebon sca nichibo jaan jato quenahah. Jaabo tiromapahonibo tihojaquin jato casticanquin: hihti tiromanibo hihti casticanxon, hashoan hicha tahma tiromanibo hashoan hicha tahmabojaquin casticanquin.
Casticanquin ta jato jatihibi chihi qui potahihqui. Jaa hian quescapah chihi janin potahihnihahbo ta hahquirihbi mahuataibo qui, rabejaquin mahuamaha jano sca banetaibo.
Jihuenicabaan quirica janin jaton jane yamahi quen chihi janin canicahbo rahsi, Papan jato jano potahah.
